PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Accenture Solutions Pvt Ltd.: AI/ML computational Science Sr Analyst: Feb 2024 – present
➢ Led the development of a GenAI based Presentation Creator Tool:
o Designed and implemented a scalable GenAI solution using OpenAI GPT models, enabling dynamic generation of
business presentations based on topic, template, and contextual document input.
o Utilized langchain to load, chunk, and retrieve data from user-uploaded files and client-specific knowledge bases,
supporting Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows.
o Applied advanced prompt engineering to ensure consistent and structured outputs for template recommendations,
o
agenda suggestions, and content generation tailored to business contexts. Integrated Milvus vector database (hosted via Docker on Azure VM) for chunk-based document storage and semantic search, enhancing the system’s retrieval capabilities.
o Built and deployed production-grade components on Azure using services such as Azure OpenAI, Azure VM, and
CI/CD pipelines, ensuring reliability and maintainability.
o Collaborated cross-functionally with frontend and PR teams and led architectural design to align with business goals
and user experience expectations.
➢
Intelligent Application Portfolio Management: o Enhanced the existing LOB recommendation engine, which initially relied on fuzzy matching and keyword analysis, by
integrating a GenAI-based model to improve accuracy.
o Contributed to the feature utilizing Sentence Transformer with BERT for generating embeddings of application descriptions, utilizing cosine similarity scoring to accurately map them to the appropriate business capabilities. o Utilized Azure Blob Storage to manage and access large-scale database files and employed the Pandas library for
merging and transforming datasets during preprocessing.
➢ Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based chatbot.
o Developed advanced features such as chat history management, reply to previous queries option for users, ensuring
o
seamless conversational flow and enhance user interaction. Integrated functionality to suggest new queries to users.
➢ Exploration of Multimodal and Agentic AI Capabilities
o Conducted hands-on experimentation with state-of-the-art multimodal LLMs including Gemini, llama, and GPT-4,
evaluating their capabilities for text, image and video inputs.
o Completed training on Accenture's Agentic AI Framework, gaining practical knowledge in designing autonomous LLM
agents capable of tool use, task orchestration
Ineda Systems Pvt. Ltd.: Senior Design Engineer (SDE): April 2016 – April 2018
Automated driving using Machine Learning ➢ Radar based target classification:
o Led the design and implementation of High-performance predictive ML model for target classification.
o Demonstrated proficiency in extracting analytical insights of data collected from FMCW radar using Matplotlib and
Seaborn libraries.
o
Implemented techniques to extract valuable statistical features from the interpreted data.
➢ Implemented several ML classification techniques like SVM (using all kinds of kernels), Random Forest, XGBoost, Principal
Component Analysis using Numpy, Scikit-learn.
Embedded Systems ➢ Self-training on embedded components of the SoCs delivered by Ineda Systems. ➢ Developed 8bit OLED display for a SoC at app, interface, engine, display driver level.
➢ Fixed bugs and implemented test cases for MPU and MCU components of the SOCs.
Samsung India Electronics Pvt Ltd – NOIDA: Software Engineer: July 2012 - Dec 2015
➢ Worked on coding and development of Application of feature phones:
o Developed new GUI screens and functionalities for FM Radio features of new phone models. o Proposed new ideas and enhanced FM radio app by adding RDS support, Alternate Frequency, background FM
recording, FM sharing via Bluetooth and SMS.
➢ Worked in White box team with the major responsibilities of code review, test-case development, code optimization,
prevention of new issues and side-effects due to code modifications for Contacts and FM. o Size Optimization of .ini files storing from 31MB to 64KB for the basic feature phones.
Professional Development (during career break from April 2018- Feb 2024)
➢ Completed "NLP Specialization" by deeplearning.ai on Coursera.
➢ Completed certification course - Deep Learning: Advanced Natural Language Processing and RNNs on Udemy.
